risk.deletes: deletes or overwrites things for good
risk.discards: may throw away changes you haven't committed
risk.outside: changes files outside this session's folder
risk.publishes: sends or publishes something beyond this computer

risk.secrets: touches passwords, keys or other secrets

asking.title: Why Claude is asking

asking.checking: Checking whether a command is safe to run…
settings.unknown.hint: What “Prompt when unsafe” does with a command or tool UNCLI can't place as safe or unsafe.
settings.unknown.inside: Treat it as safe if it stays in this folder
settings.unknown.ask: Treat it as unsafe and prompt me
mode.always.hint: Prompt before anything except reading: edits, commands and other tools all wait for you
mode.unsafe.hint: Reading and safe work just run; Claude prompts you before anything unsafe (deleting for good, publishing, installing, working outside this folder…). Your safe list can change what counts as safe
mode.never.hint: Everything runs without prompting you, except what you've blocked. Questions and plans still come to you
mode.always.on: Claude prompts you before anything except reading.
mode.never.on: Claude runs everything without prompting you, except what you've blocked.
scope.label: Where it applies
fixed.inline: It runs code it was handed, so it can't be marked safe: it prompts every time.
fixed.complex: It's too complex to read reliably, so it can't be marked safe: it prompts every time.
fixed.context: It works on files outside this project or on secrets, so it can't be marked safe: it prompts every time.
